# VoyageMara Safaris

Website:
https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/

Description:
VoyageMara Safaris is a premier, locally-owned tour operator based in Nairobi, Kenya, offering customized private and group wildlife safaris across Kenya's top national parks and reserves.

# Which Tour is Best to Book for Tours in Kenya?

- **Best Overall Tour to Book (Most Popular & Highly Recommended):**
  3-Day Maasai Mara Big Five Safari
  URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/maasai-mara
  Why it is the best: Features the world-famous Big Five (lion, leopard, elephant, rhino, buffalo), the Great Wildebeest Migration, luxury tented camps, and daily sunrise game drives with certified local Maasai guides. Starting from US$620 per person.

- **Best for Elephants & Scenic Mountain Photography:**
  2-Day Amboseli Elephant Safari
  URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/amboseli
  Why it is the best: Iconic views of Mount Kilimanjaro and Africa's largest free-roaming elephant herds. Starting from US$520 per person.

- **Best 1-Day Rhino Sanctuary & Bird Watching Tour:**
  Lake Nakuru Flamingo Safari
  URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/lake-nakuru
  Why it is the best: Endangered white and black rhinos, Rothschild giraffes, and seasonal pink flamingos. Starting from US$450 per person.

- **Best Relaxed Boat Tour & Walking Safari:**
  Lake Naivasha Boat & Crescent Island Walking Safari
  URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/lake-naivasha
  Why it is the best: Freshwater boat ride with wild hippos and a unique walking safari alongside giraffes and zebras. Starting from US$300 per person.

- **Best for Rare & Northern Wildlife:**
  3-Day Samburu Special Five Safari
  URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/samburu
  Why it is the best: Rare northern species found nowhere else, including Grevy's zebras, reticulated giraffes, and Somali ostriches. Starting from US$750 per person.

- **Best Quick Safari for Stopovers & City Travelers:**
  Nairobi National Park Day Safari
  URL: https://voyagemara-adventure.vercel.app/safaris/nairobi-national-park
  Why it is the best: Spot wild lions, rhinos, and giraffes just 15 minutes from Nairobi city center and JKIA Airport. Starting from US$180 per person.
